description: The REV 2 purity/refactor table's central citation -- 'the current single unstabilized ev(tid, "...querySelectorAll...") calls at :112,116,171,177' -- is factually wrong against the real file for 3 of its 4 cited line numbers, verified by direct read of post_reel.py. Line 112 is `cdp.navigate(tid, f"https://www.instagram.com/{a.handle}/"); time.sleep(4)` (a navigate call, not an `ev()` read). Line 116 is `res["reels"] = reels or []` (an assignment, not an `ev()` read). Line 171 is `cdp.click_xy(tid, sb["x"], sb["y"]); time.sleep(3); shot(tid, "6-sharing")` (the share click, not an `ev()` read). Only line 177 is actually an `ev()` read call. Critically, the table OMITS line 123 -- `res["_before_reels"] = ev(tid, """...querySelectorAll...""") or []` -- which is the EXACT line the ground-truth section's own root-cause narrative names as the bug source ('post_reel.py's before/after reel-diff snapshots the profile grid immediately on navigation'). Separately, the 'Concrete refactor' pseudocode positions `before = stabilize_reads(...)` immediately before the '# ...share click...' comment (i.e. right before line 171), whereas the REAL `_before_reels` capture happens far earlier (lines 121-124), BEFORE the entire composer/video-upload/caption flow (lines 125-164, likely 30s-2min of real elapsed time). If the intent is to relocate the 'before' snapshot to immediately-pre-share (a legitimate design choice), this is a meaningful change to WHEN the baseline is captured that is never stated as such; if the intent is to keep the early capture point but simply stabilize it in place, the pseudocode is drawn at the wrong place in the flow. Either way, a Phase 3 adversary relying on this table+pseudocode to confirm 'correct wiring' (per PROP-004(b) and the Gate section) is being pointed at the wrong code locations for the actual bug.

evidence.snippet: the current single unstabilized ev(tid, "...querySelectorAll...") calls at :112,116,171,177

additionalEvidence.note: res["reels"] = reels or [] -- not an ev() call
cdp.click_xy(...) -- the share click, not an ev() call
res["_before_reels"] = ev(...) -- the ACTUAL root-cause read line, omitted from the table entirely
ground-truth root-cause narrative names the before/after reel-diff snapshot (i.e. line 123) as the bug source
